correctness.rationale: For X_a(u), telescoping p^h=1+sum_{j=1}^h phi(p^j) gives mean k+1 on the units. Let P_j be averaging within reduction classes modulo p^j and P_0 averaging over all units. The centered data matrix is H=M(sum_{j=1}^k P_j-kP_0), symmetric, so the covariance is H^2/M. The orthogonal difference of the j-th and (j-1)-st images sees eigenvalue M(k-j+1)^2 of the covariance, with dimension the difference of the reduction-image dimensions. Constants form the kernel. Counting products with min(i,j)=l in P_i P_j=P_min(i,j) gives the stated entry formula. For the empirical law, masses at j^2 with j<k agree, the deficit at k^2 is 1/(pM), and the missing tail is (p-1)/(pM); their sum is exactly the extra mass 1/M at zero. The empty positive spectrum for p=2,k=1 and the missing first contrast level when p=2 are correctly treated, including the condition number when there is a positive spectrum. The uploaded integer/rational checker was inspected read-only; the all-parameter result follows from the proof.

evidence: For n=p^k the conductor p^l gives the data eigenvalue M tau(p^{k-l})=M(k-l+1). An exact-conductor count subtracts successive numbers of characters factoring through reduction. On constants G=M(k+1); mean subtraction deletes this eigenvalue and is zero on other characters.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The spectrum follows by squaring and dividing by M; all rank and condition results follow from its extrema. The projectors onto conductors at most p^j are exactly the residue-class averages by character orthogonality. Writing the squared diagonal in their successive differences gives the entry formula by telescoping. The geometric atom masses match through j<k, and TV is the displaced mass at zero. Full-ring additive transforms are not the reason for FAIL.

originality.rationale: Zhao–Cao's Dirichlet-character Menon identity already gives the full Fourier diagonal of the unit-indexed data kernel for every modulus, not merely the scalar first moment. Centering and squaring make the proposed covariance spectrum a direct corollary. The arithmetic entry formula and the exact total variation are routine consequences of this same diagonal, not a surviving independent claim.
residual_risks: The historical search is bounded; the explicit earlier all-modulus identity is sufficient regardless of whether the precise covariance phrasing appeared elsewhere.

value.rationale: The covariance model and comparison distribution are natural, and the calculation is a useful exposition. But the proposed exact invariant mechanically follows from the known full data-kernel Fourier diagonal, and the finite TV identity just counts the mass transferred to the constant mode. No separate unknown and independently useful exact invariant remains in the frozen contribution.
